Yes, that makes sense. You want the roll pool to expand based on the player’s sensor level:
Sensors 0: Fail only Sensors 1: Fail OR Sensor 1 success Sensors 2: Fail OR Sensor 1 success OR Sensor 2 success Sensors 3: Fail OR Sensor 1 success OR Sensor 2 success OR Sensor 3 success Sensors 4: Fail OR Sensor 1 success OR Sensor 2 success OR Sensor 3 success OR Sensor 4 success
The clean XML method is:
1. Use hidden sensor-level choices to choose the correct roll pool. 2. Each roll pool is an eventList. 3. The eventList randomly selects one result. 4. The selected result event is the only thing the player sees.
So the player does not see five choices. The game rolls from the available list and then shows only the selected outcome.
